stage_info.name: heterogeneity_analysis
stage_info.description: Heterogeneity analysis stage: Determine true number of classes using ab initio + heterogeneous refinement and density comparison

heterogeneity_analysis.convergence_threshold_description: Number of additional classes detected to consider converged (default: 0, meaning no new classes)
heterogeneity_analysis.resolution_threshold_description: Resolution threshold in Angstroms - groups with worse resolution are discarded (default: 12.0)
heterogeneity_analysis.ab_initio_initial_resolution_description: Initial resolution (Å) for ab initio reconstruction (default: 9.0)
heterogeneity_analysis.ab_initio_final_resolution_description: Final/maximum resolution (Å) for ab initio reconstruction (default: 7.0)
heterogeneity_analysis.use_nonuniform_refinement_description: Use non-uniform refinement for final refinement of each group (default: true)
heterogeneity_analysis.refine_res_init_description: Initial lowpass resolution (Å) for refinement. If null, uses CryoSPARC default (typically 30Å).

density_comparison.voxel_size_description: Voxel size in Angstroms for density comparison (default: 5.0)
density_comparison.source_contour_level_description: Source contour level for density comparison (default: 0.01)
density_comparison.target_contour_level_description: Target contour level for density comparison (default: 0.01)
density_comparison.alg_type_description: Algorithm type for density comparison: 'global' or 'local' (default: 'global')
density_comparison.n_clusters_description: Number of clusters for density grouping (null = auto-detect, default: null)
density_comparison.keep_work_dir_description: Keep working directory after comparison (default: false)
density_comparison.no_rms_threshold_description: Disable RMS threshold for density comparison (default: false)

external_tools.eman2_conda_env_description: Conda environment name for EMAN2 tools (optional)
external_tools.docker_container_description: Docker container name for CryoAlign tools (optional)

script_paths.compare_all_densities_script_description: Path to compare_all_densities.py script. If null, auto-detects from alignment_tools folder or project root. Default: null (auto-detect)
script_paths.align_and_compare_script_description: Path to align_and_compare_maps.py script. If null, auto-detects from project root. Default: null (auto-detect)
